column12: JUDGEMENT on the line. QUINTESSENTIAL's primary endpoint is in patients after four or more prior lines, the population FDA wrote the first labels of Abecma, Carvykti, Tecvayli, Talvey and Elrexfio to, so the fifth-line share is taken. BMS names the setting 4L+ and the trial met response after three or more lines as a secondary; the fourth-line share is (2,971 + 954) / 24,825 = 15.81%, and the uptake anchor below is struck on the same fifth-line pool, so choosing the wider pool would lower the capture and leave modelled patients about the same. Not taken off: prior BCMA-targeted therapy, which the label will likely require (no US share of fifth-line patients with BCMA exposure was found), and prior GPRC5D therapy, which the trial excludes. Fonseca counts treated patients in data to 2018; longer survival on newer regimens may take more patients to a fifth line
